definitions.explanation: The act of bringing in or implementing something new, such as a system, technology, or policy.

examples.japanese: {私鉄|してつ}{各社|かくしゃ}がICカードを{導入|どうにゅう}した。
examples.english: Each private railway company introduced IC cards.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいシステムを{導入|どうにゅう}する。
examples.english: We will implement a new system.

examples.japanese: {導入|どうにゅう}コストが{高|たか}い。

notes:
USAGE: Often used in business and technical contexts for implementing new systems, technologies, or policies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{導入|どうにゅう}する (to introduce/implement)
・{導入|どうにゅう}コスト (implementation cost)
・{導入|どうにゅう}{事例|じれい} (case studies of implementation)
・{段階的|だんかいてき}{導入|どうにゅう} (phased implementation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{採用|さいよう} (adoption)
・{実施|じっし} (implementation - for policies/plans)
